```{r}
gpt_dosedata <- left_join(gpt_full,dose_data, by = ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!8)
gpt_dosedata
```


```{r}
# Erzeuge eine neue Tabelle mit den kombinierten Medikamenten pro Patient
med_summary <- gpt_dosedata %>%
  filter(Kathegorie != "Cummulative Dosis")%>%
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%
  summarise(multi_med = paste(sort(unique(Treatment.y)), collapse = "+"), .groups = "drop")

# Füge diese Info wieder an den Originaldatensatz an
gpt_dosedata_multi <- gpt_dosedata %>%
  left_join(med_summary, by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2")
gpt_dosedata_multi
```

```{r}
gpt_dosedata_multi %>% 
  filter(Treatment.y == "Diclofenac") %>% 
  filter(Treatment.x == "Leber_Diclo") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
```


```{r}
# 1. Nur eindeutige Patienten-Medikamenten-Kombinationen
patienten_medikamente <- gpt_dosedata_multi %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, multi_med)

# 2. Anzahl Patienten pro Medikamentenkombination
kombination_counts <- patienten_medikamente %>%
  count(multi_med, name = "patient_count") %>%
  arrange(multi_med)

# 3. Balkendiagramm mit Patientenzahlen als Labels
ggplot(kombination_counts, aes(x = multi_med, y = patient_count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("N=", patient_count)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Patient count for medication combination",
    x = "Medication combination",
    y = "Patient count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```




```{r}
# Step 1: Prepare your data
gpt_full_filtered_prepared <- gpt_dosedata_multi %>% 
  mutate(
    multi_med = as.factor(multi_med),
    `Edited_BfArM Nummer2` = as.factor(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`)
  ) %>%
  # 👉 Duplikate auf Patienten-ID + Messtag + Labwert-Ebene entfernen
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, attribute, labreads, .keep_all = TRUE)%>% 
  filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment.x)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(attribute, "_From Start|_From start|DBS"))
    
# Step 2: Filter only treatments with "Leber" and count unique patients per group
group_counts <- gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  group_by(multi_med) %>%
  summarise(total_unique = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Calculate maximum labreads value per group (for positioning labels above the boxes)
y_pos <- gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>%
  group_by(multi_med) %>%
  summarise(y = max(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05, .groups = "drop")

# Step 4: Join counts and y-positions into one dataframe
group_counts <- left_join(group_counts, y_pos, by = "multi_med")

# Step 5: Create the base plot (can use all data or filtered data)
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_multi <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = gpt_full_filtered_prepared %>% filter(grepl("Leber", Treatment.x)),  # plot only Leber treatments
  x = multi_med,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  title = "liver_alt_full_comparison of GPT between NSAID-groups", # ALT for labvalue and daily dose
  xlab = "NSAID intake",
  ylab = "GPT (U/L)"
)

# Step 6: Add count labels to the plot
liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_multi <- liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_multi + 
  geom_text(
    data = group_counts,
    aes(
      x = multi_med,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("N = ", total_unique)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6.5,
    vjust = -0.5
  )

liver_gpt_full_comparison_of_nsaid_groups_multi

```
